description: Phabricator T146747: opening a link from a scrolled article opens the new article scrolled to some position instead of at the top.
expected_report: In the Wikipedia app the user scrolls down an article, taps a wikilink (link preview, 'Artikel lesen'), and the new article opens scrolled down somewhere related to the previous scroll position. Expected: the new page opens at the top.
difficulty: German UI, link-preview sheets, the evidence is the scroll position of the newly opened article.
